_about: Advisory -> vulnerable symbols. Curated by hand for the demo; during the event the Bob 'advisory-analyst' subagent proposes new entries into .gatekeeper/symbols.local.json for review.

CVE-2020-14343.note: Arbitrary code execution when untrusted YAML is loaded with the full/unsafe loader.

CVE-2018-18074.note: Authorization header kept on HTTPS->HTTP redirect; any outbound call that follows redirects with credentials.

CVE-2023-32681.note: Proxy-Authorization header leaked to destination on redirect when proxies are configured.

CVE-2024-35195.note: A Session that first calls with verify=False keeps skipping TLS verification for that host.

CVE-2024-47081.note: .netrc credentials can be sent to a host chosen by a malicious URL.

CVE-2024-56326.note: Sandbox breakout via indirect reference to format.

CVE-2025-27516.note: Sandbox breakout through the attr filter.

CVE-2024-22195.note: xmlattr filter accepts keys with spaces (attribute injection).

CVE-2024-34064.note: xmlattr filter accepts keys with / > = (attribute injection).
